en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

All that flowing blood should be offered to
Atua instead.
I wish they would share it with my island.
He doesn't understand the funny parts.
I wanna watch a relaxing animated movie.

Not one with unneccessary sci-fi stuff that'll
make Atua's head spin.

Atua really likes animated movies that have
cute animals in them.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
